decision_lens: Ask of every dimension: is this a genuinely distinct pitch, or is it G-sharp to some other dimension's A-flat — the same key spelled twice? And ask of the schema as a whole: is there a declared reference pitch and interval contract that lets anyone test whether a written value is in tune? Prefer a smaller, well-tempered set that every one of the six consuming instruments can play cleanly over a maximal set that is pure nowhere and silently overweights whichever region got the most duplicate keys. Rank any migration by whether it retunes the instrument WITH its recordings and pitch-locked players accounted for (grandfather vs. re-cut, index rebuild, affinity recalibration) versus a silent retune that leaves the corpus beating against the new standard.
distance_rationale: Temperament theory is a craft refined over five centuries (Pythagoras through Werckmeister, Rameau, and the tuning-fork standardization of A) around the exact structural problems this schema faces, with zero shared parent discipline with textual criticism, garden design, data-platform engineering, statistics, or any banned AI-cliche domain. A fixed-pitch instrument has a FINITE number of physical keys (dimensions) that must be mapped onto an infinite continuum of possible pitches (personality space); the tuner's central discovery is that many notionally distinct notes COLLAPSE enharmonically (G-sharp IS A-flat on a tempered keyboard) — the precise isomorphism of 'which of 29 dimensions are the same axis under another name.' A pitch value is meaningless without a declared reference (A=440) and defined intervals — the scale-anchoring contract the brief says is undefined. And a keyboard, once tuned and its repertoire recorded, cannot be silently retuned without breaking every recording made against it — the append-only vintage/migration problem exactly. The craft reasons in commas, beats, temperaments, and reference pitches, not factors or vectors.
expected_isomorphisms: enharmonic equivalence (G-sharp = A-flat on a tempered keyboard) ↔ collapsed dimensions: two named dimensions (Cognition / Information Processing; Volition / Ambition) that resolve to the same underlying pitch are not two axes but one key spelled two ways — the tuner's test for genuine vs. spurious distinctness is whether they ever need to sound DIFFERENT in the repertoire (do the consumers ever weight them independently)

the syntonic comma / it-does-not-close ↔ the redundancy that overweights an axis: stacking pure intervals overshoots the octave by a comma; stacking three near-duplicate dimensions (Empathy/Nurturing/Emotional Processing) into a cosine index overweights that region of personality space by a 'comma' the affinity math cannot hear but silently mis-rewards

reference pitch A=440 + defined intervals ↔ the missing scale-anchoring contract: a note is untestable until you fix a reference and the interval ratios; 'Manifestation 0.43' is a pitch with no tuning fork — demand a per-dimension anchor (what 0.0 and 1.0 sound like) and behavioral interval correlates or the value is unfalsifiable

temperament choice (just / meantone / equal) as an explicit, declared compromise ↔ the factor-structure decision: equal temperament trades pure intervals for the ability to play in every key (fewer clean factors, universal usability) vs. just intonation (many keys, pure but unplayable across the corpus) — the trim/keep/restructure choice is a temperament choice that must be DECLARED, not defaulted into

you cannot silently retune a keyboard that has recordings ↔ append-only vintage doctrine: every one of the 451 scored creatures is a 'recording' cut against the current tuning; a schema retune is a new temperament that either grandfathers old recordings at their original pitch or re-cuts them all — and the cosine index + After Them affinity math are instruments pinned to the old tuning that will beat audibly against a retuned corpus

the well-tempered compromise (Werckmeister) ↔ a defensible trimmed core: the historically winning move was not maximum purity but a tempered set playable everywhere; the analogue is a smaller dimension set tuned so every consumer (six games) can play it, over a maximal 29 that is pure nowhere

This reviewer hears redundant dimensions as enharmonic duplicates, an unanchored scale as a pitch with no tuning fork, and a schema change as a retuning that will make every recording cut against the old temperament beat audibly out of tune.
